crashScreen.title: Something went wrong
crashScreen.body: Sorry, the app just ran into an error. You can export the log to send us, or reload the app.
crashScreen.exportNote: The log stays on this device and is never uploaded automatically; it includes device and error details—share only with trusted support.
crashScreen.emptyBody: No crashes have been recorded yet.
crashScreen.shareUnavailableBody: This device can't share, or sharing was canceled.
